title: Prove sharp uniform error from transient transfer leakage (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove a sharp uniform physical operator-error certificate from a strictly contracting transient virtual block. Claim type: scoped written proof with finite exact corroboration.

```text
complete fixed triangular residual table
  active block norm <= 1
  transient block norm <= rho < 1
  leakage norm <= delta
  complete error at width f <= sqrt(alpha beta) delta (1-rho^f)/(1-rho)
```

A two-state rational family attains the bound at every width. Its uniform supremum is exactly delta/(1-rho), although no positive-definite Hermitian metric makes the entire local table contractive in that representation. With delta=1/1024 and rho=1/2, each finite-width error is strictly below 1/512, with supremum exactly 1/512.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit zxv / #5441 for the fixed physical table contract and approximation opening, and Ali Romman / #5451 for the coherent whole-table sufficient metric certificate and physical norm argument. Classical block products, weighted norms, geometric series and PSD null-row arguments retain their credit, together with the retained automata, matrix-product, native, phase and compiler lineage. These predecessors are cited premises, not replay or audit targets. No global literature-priority claim is made.

## Evidence

The new certificate admits the displayed bounded family outside #5451's sufficient test in its exact two-state representation. The proof includes all physical entries and complete input/output roles, with no growing payload-dimension factor.

- All 65,520 physical word endpoints in eight rational families, widths 1..12, confirm 96 exact norms.
- Six certificates give 24 complete physical operators with 4,080 entries, including noncommuting actions, physical mixing, multiple roles and a nonidentity metric. Literal weighted and unweighted endpoint matrices agree.
- Exact Schur PSD tests agree with independent principal-minor/permutation-determinant arithmetic on all 729 symmetric ternary three-by-three matrices. Another 32 fixtures corroborate the incompatible metric equations. All 13 invalid certificates reject, including coherent cross-input leakage and omitted role charges.
- Standard-library CPython 3.12.15 warning-strict normal and optimized replays pass, with identical generated hash-bound receipts. Direct check durations were 1.07 s and 0.99 s; the final registered pair took 2.21 s total locally. These are check durations, not speedup claims. AST diagnostics pass; Ruff is unavailable.
- Official committed export and declared-input integrity checks pass. An optimized standard-library-only replay from a read-only Git-free export, with empty PATH, emits the identical receipt.
- Registered package validation and committed-byte/source-history preflight pass at 9128443f5ea637ebc9a07932baff413a6c39df8c. No predecessor scientific executable was run.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/transfer-transient-leakage/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/transfer-transient-leakage/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/transfer-transient-leakage
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/transfer-transient-leakage --check-source-history
```

Another CPython 3.12 executable may replace the local path. Expected markers are PASS_TRANSFER_TRANSIENT_LEAKAGE, PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE and PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES. The direct checker is read-only and requires neither Git nor network access. It emits a generated receipt binding all six package files.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The theorem requires a fixed triangular residual representation, an exact lower-left zero, complete role boundaries and the stated coherent block inequalities. It is a sufficient criterion, not a classification of all bounded families or a nonlinear-rounding theorem. The metric obstruction is representation-specific.

No actual selected native word or consumer is bound to this certificate. Physical realization, source/version extraction, coefficient access, required dirty restoration outside the represented endpoint, movement, storage, precision, stock, recursive compilation and exact-recovery funding remain open. No new kappa or selected-frontier change. All five selected framework assumptions remain. No selected scientific cold replay, Lean or Docker run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

The formal-interface-lemma card changes to this written numerical-interface side result. Canonical main was refreshed before publication and remained 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a, priority revision 8, selected PR6030. Live latest-100 open bodies, account submissions, current handoffs, local reservations and main/merged general-form searches were checked. A broader cached scan covers 572 open PRs and 6,637 Discussion records with complete remote pagination; sparse local notes, arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work remain limits.

## Open next questions

- Extract one actual consumer's complete residual and establish its exact triangular zero and useful block metrics. Physical access and an independent recovery tolerance remain blockers.
- Realize one such local transfer physically, retaining the split and every required return, and price preparation, use and cleanup in the complete invoice.

## Related open work

No open PR studying this transient-leakage error quantity was identified in the fresh publication search or targeted cached scan. Merged #5441 and #5451 are the credited interface predecessors. Merged #6184 studies arithmetic chirp cut spectra and bond lower bounds, a different question from the uniform error certificate proved here. No additional computation checked another contribution.
